steps.title: 检查磁盘空间
steps.hint: 建议预留 ≥60GB（8B 权重约 18GB + torch / 依赖约 12GB）。空间不够判 low_disk，停在这一步。

moss.disk.low_space.zh: 磁盘剩余约 {free}GB，低于建议的 {want}GB（8B 权重 + CUDA torch + 依赖）。清理磁盘或换一个剩余空间足够的安装目录后重跑。
moss.disk.low_space.en: the disk has about {free}GB free, below the suggested {want}GB (the 8B weight set + CUDA torch + dependencies). Free up space or pick a different install directory and re-run.

moss.disk.unreadable.zh: 无法读取安装目录所在磁盘的剩余空间：{err}。
moss.disk.unreadable.en: cannot read the free space of the drive holding the install directory: {err}.

steps.title: 准备 Python 3.12 并建虚拟环境（uv）
steps.hint: 用 uv 取 Python 3.12（本机没有就自己下，缓存到安装目录的 tools\uv-cache），在隔离的 .venv 里装依赖；不碰系统 Python。

moss.python.failed.zh: Python 3.12 / 虚拟环境准备失败：{tail}。多半是网络（取 uv 或 Python 时 Github / npmmirror 不可达）或安装目录不可写。确认网络后重跑本步即可（已下载的 uv 与解释器会复用）；也可以自己装一个 Python 3.12 后把 uv 加进 PATH。
moss.python.failed.en: preparing Python 3.12 / the virtual environment failed: {tail}. Usually the network (GitHub / npmmirror unreachable while fetching uv or Python) or a non-writable install directory. Re-run this step once the network is fine (a fetched uv and interpreter are reused), or install Python 3.12 yourself and put uv on PATH.

steps.title: 安装 CUDA torch 2.9.1+cu128
steps.hint: 官方要求 torch 2.9.1+cu128 / torchaudio 2.9.1+cu128；镜像顺序 SJTU → 阿里云 → 官方。装完立刻验 cuda.is_available()。

moss.torch.cuda_unavailable.zh: torch 装上了但 cuda.is_available() 为 false：装的是 CPU 版 torch，或本机 NVIDIA 驱动不支持 cu128（驱动主版本需 ≥ 525，建议 550+）。升级驱动后重跑本步。原始探针输出：{probe}
moss.torch.cuda_unavailable.en: torch is installed but cuda.is_available() is false: either the CPU build got installed, or the local NVIDIA driver does not support cu128 (driver major >= 525, 550+ recommended). Upgrade the driver and re-run this step. Raw probe output: {probe}

moss.torch.install_failed.zh: CUDA torch 安装失败：{tail}。三个镜像（SJTU / 阿里云 pytorch-wheels / 官方 download.pytorch.org）都没装上，通常是网络或磁盘问题；确认能访问镜像后重跑本步。
moss.torch.install_failed.en: CUDA torch install failed: {tail}. All three indexes (SJTU / Aliyun pytorch-wheels / official download.pytorch.org) failed, usually the network or the disk; make sure an index is reachable and re-run this step.

steps.title: 安装推理依赖（transformers 4.57.1 等）
steps.hint: transformers 固定 4.57.1，另含 accelerate / torchcodec / soundfile / modelscope / bitsandbytes；pip 依次试清华 / 阿里云 / USTC / 官方 PyPI。

moss.deps.pip_failed.zh: 依赖安装失败：{tail}。pip 已依次试过清华 / 阿里云 / USTC / 官方 PyPI；若日志里是「No matching distribution found for 某包」，就是该包在四个源上都没同步、按包名上报；否则看本步日志尾部的原始报错后重跑。
moss.deps.pip_failed.en: dependency install failed: {tail}. pip already tried Tsinghua / Aliyun / USTC / official PyPI in order; if the log says 'No matching distribution found for <package>', that package is not synced on those four indexes (report the package name); otherwise read the raw error in this step's log tail and re-run.

steps.title: 下载官方推理源码（zip，不用 git）
steps.hint: 从 codeload.github.com 拉 main 分支 zip，失败回退 gh-proxy / ghfast / ghproxy 三个镜像；解到 <安装目录>\source\MOSS-Music。

moss.source.download_failed.zh: 官方源码下载失败：{tail}。codeload 与三个 GitHub 代理都不可达时会发生；网络恢复后重跑本步（已解出的源码会复用，加 -ForceSource 可强制重下）。
moss.source.download_failed.en: downloading the official source failed: {tail}. This happens when codeload and all three GitHub proxies are unreachable; re-run once the network is back (an extracted copy is reused; pass -ForceSource to force a fresh download).

steps.title: 下载官方 8B 权重
steps.hint: MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct，约 18GB。ModelScope 优先，失败回退 hf-mirror；已完成分片复用。

moss.weights.download_failed.zh: 权重下载失败：{err}。ModelScope 与 hf-mirror 都没成功；确认网络后重跑（已下载的分片会复用）。也可以手工把仓库的全部文件放到 <安装目录>\models\MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct 后重跑，脚本会直接认。
moss.weights.download_failed.en: weight download failed: {err}. Both ModelScope and hf-mirror failed; re-run once the network is fine (finished shards are reused). You can also copy every file of the repo into <install dir>\models\MOSS-Music-8B-Instruct by hand and re-run - the script accepts them as-is.

moss.files.incomplete.zh: 文件不完整：{err}。重跑安装补齐（权重支持续传）；模型目录必须有 config.json 且 safetensors 合计 ≥1GB。
moss.files.incomplete.en: files are incomplete: {err}. Re-run the install to fill the gaps (weight downloads resume); the model folder needs config.json and >=1GB of safetensors.

steps.title: 下载便携 ffmpeg
steps.hint: 用于解码与长音频切片（>5 分钟切 3 分钟段 + 5 秒重叠）。下不到只跳过本步，生成时会明确报缺 ffmpeg。

moss.env.write_failed.zh: 写 .env 失败：{err}。安装目录不可写（权限 / 被占用）时会这样；换目录或解除占用后重跑。
moss.env.write_failed.en: writing .env failed: {err}. This happens when the install directory is not writable (permissions / locked); pick another directory or release the lock and re-run.

steps.title: 冒烟：导入官方推理包并验 CUDA
steps.hint: 只导入 torch / transformers / src.hf_inference，不加载 18GB 权重；通过后写 .install-ok。

moss.smoke.cuda_unavailable.zh: 冒烟时 torch 看不到 CUDA（cuda False）：虚拟机没直通显卡、驱动掉了，或装完 torch 后被别的包换成了 CPU 版。先确认 nvidia-smi 可用，再重跑本步。
moss.smoke.cuda_unavailable.en: torch cannot see CUDA during the smoke check (cuda False): the VM has no GPU passthrough, the driver dropped, or another package swapped torch for the CPU build. Make sure nvidia-smi works, then re-run this step.

moss.smoke.import_failed.zh: 冒烟导入失败：{err}。依赖装了一半、transformers 版本被换掉，或源码目录不完整；看这一步日志后重跑安装。
moss.smoke.import_failed.en: the smoke import failed: {err}. Dependencies are half installed, transformers got replaced, or the source tree is incomplete; read this step's log and re-run the install.
